messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: conda envirement
parts:
Dear Samra, I'm sorry I missed this message at the time. When you run R, what does 

py_config()

return? I am not sure which conda environment R is finding, but ideally you would want it to be like the one in the second screen. You can probably delete your second miniconda install and try again. One question might be what the permissions are on 'C:/Users/samra/AppData/Local/r-miniconda/' i.e. whether you can write to that folder.

Best, Greg.
